items.title: HAL Q1 Results: Net profit rises 15% YoY to Rs 1,590 crore, revenue up 14%
items.description: Hindustan Aeronautics reported an impressive fifteen percent increase in net profit for the first quarter, showcasing robust financial health. Alongside, the company observed a fourteen percent year-on-year rise in operational revenue for the April-June period of the fiscal year twenty twenty-seven. Released on a Wednesday, the findings revealed that HAL shares experienced slight gains following this promising report.

items.title: Tata Motors CV Q1 Results: Net profit soars 83% YoY to Rs 2,560 cr on one-time gain from Tata Capital; revenue jumps 19%
items.description: Tata Motors CV Q1 Results: Commercial vehicle major Tata Motors on Wednesday reported a net profit of Rs 2,560 in the first quarter of financial year 2027, marking a jump of 83.3% from Rs 1,397 crore reported in the same period last year.
